meta.title: 面试表现一般却通过了？面试官视角解读
meta.title_en: Passed Despite a Mediocre Interview? A Recruiter's View

scenes.context: 讲者提出问题：面试表现一般却通过，从面试官视角有原因可循。
sentences: 自己面试表现一般般，最后竟然通过了。
I interviewed so-so, but somehow I still passed.
表现一般般：interview so-so
面试官也可能觉得一般。
Even the interviewer probably thought it was mediocre.
觉得一般：thought it was mediocre
这种情况主要有三个原因。
There are three main reasons behind this.
三个原因：three main reasons
paraphrase: 表现一般 ≠ 结果一定差
A so-so interview doesn't mean a bad outcome.
结果 → 从面试官视角解释
The outcome makes sense from the interviewer's side.
scenes.speak: I interviewed so-so, but somehow I still passed. Even the interviewer probably thought it was mediocre. There are three main reasons behind this.

scenes.context: 讲者说明招人难导致标准放低，以及自我感觉不等于真实表现。
sentences: 现在招人真的非常难，公司求贤若渴。
Hiring is really tough right now, and companies are desperate for talent.
求贤若渴：desperate for talent
只要你不是特别差，基本上就会通过。
As long as you're not awful, you'll mostly pass.
不是特别差：not awful
自我感觉差，不一定代表真实表现就差。
Feeling you did badly doesn't mean you actually did.
自我感觉差：feel you did badly
paraphrase: 市场供需 → 影响通过标准
Market supply and demand shift the bar.
你的感觉 → 不是评价标准
scenes.speak: Hiring is really tough right now, and companies are desperate for talent. As long as you're not awful, you'll mostly pass. Feeling you did badly doesn't mean you actually did.

scenes.context: 讲者说明表现一般却通过，可能是表现恰好匹配岗位需求。
sentences: 你面试中的表现可能正好对应岗位的需求。
Your interview might have hit exactly what the role needed.
对应需求：hit what the role needed
你觉得表现一般的部分，可能恰恰是公司看重的。
The parts you thought were weak might be exactly what they value.
恰恰看重：exactly what they value
不要因为自我感觉一般就否定自己。
Don't write yourself off just because you felt meh.
否定自己：write yourself off
paraphrase: 你的表现 → 匹配需求才重要
What matters is how your performance fits the role.
感觉一般 → 不否定自己
Feeling meh shouldn't make you write yourself off.
scenes.speak: Your interview might have hit exactly what the role needed. The parts you thought were weak might be exactly what they value. Don't write yourself off just because you felt meh.

practice: I thought the interview went badly, but I still got the offer.
Companies are desperate for talent these days.
表达「自我感觉不代表真实」
Feeling you did badly doesn't mean you actually did.
Don't write yourself off over one mediocre interview.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：My interview performance is average average.
✓ 地道说法：I thought the interview was so-so.
表现一般用 so-so，不用叠词。
✕ 直译腔：The company thirsts for talents.
✓ 地道说法：Companies are desperate for talent.
求贤若渴用 desperate for talent。
✕ 直译腔：My feeling is not equal to real performance.
✓ 地道说法：Feeling you did badly doesn't mean you actually did.
感觉≠真实用 feel 与 did 对照。
✓ 地道说法：Don't write yourself off.
否定自己用 write yourself off。
shifts: 通过与否看需求匹配，不看感觉
